description: English read-only VAG record catalog, unverified MHS2 candidates, and isolated synthetic demo recipes. Optional catalog entries do not expand default captures.

entries.name: VIN
entries.description: Vehicle identifier reported by the ECU. The raw bytes, including padding, are retained for exact identity checks.

entries.name: VW spare part number
entries.description: VAG spare-part identifier reported by the ECU. A matching name alone does not establish feature-map compatibility.

entries.name: Application software version
entries.description: Application software version reported by the ECU. This is part of the exact fingerprint for a reviewed write definition.

entries.name: ECU hardware part number
entries.description: Hardware part identifier reported by the ECU. This is part of the exact fingerprint for a reviewed write definition.

entries.name: Hardware version
entries.description: Hardware revision reported by the ECU. Displayed as text while preserving the original bytes.

entries.name: System name
entries.description: System or engine-type name reported by the ECU. Availability depends on the installed controller.

entries.name: ASAM/ODX file identifier
entries.description: ASAM/ODX diagnostic-description identifier. Use it with the software and hardware identity when matching a feature definition.

entries.name: ASAM/ODX file version
entries.description: ASAM/ODX diagnostic-description version. A definition for a different version must not authorize a write.

entries.name: VAG coding value (raw; feature map unknown)
entries.description: Raw coding record for 5F. No real MHS2 byte or bit feature layout is verified; this entry is read-only and long live writes are unsupported.

entries.name: Experimental candidate 22AD (meaning unverified)
source: User read-only audi_mhs2_ble_probe.py, 2026-10-15; no verified layout or Apple_DIO offset
entries.description: Read candidate retained from the earlier MHS2 probe. Its meaning and layout are unknown; it does not identify Apple_DIO or CarPlay state.

source: Synthetic Audi Workbench simulator fixture; not a vehicle coding definition
entries.evidence: Deterministic synthetic ECU fixture, verified by simulator tests. No applicability to physical vehicles.
entries.name: DEMO ONLY: display settings
entries.description: Synthetic four-byte settings record for practicing preview, backup, apply and restore. Its animation and brightness fields do not describe a real Audi controller.

source: Synthetic Audi Workbench simulator fixture; not a vehicle coding definition
entries.evidence: Deterministic synthetic ECU fixture, verified by simulator tests. No applicability to physical vehicles.
entries.name: DEMO ONLY: synthetic long coding
entries.description: Synthetic twenty-byte coding record for exercising a long-value edit and restore in the simulator. This does not establish live outgoing ISO-TP support.

entries.name: ECU serial number
entries.description: Serial identifier reported by the controller. This record can contain identifying information; its availability on MHS2 is not yet verified.

entries.name: FAZIT identifier
entries.description: VAG FAZIT identification string reported by the controller. This is optional identifying evidence, not an activation key.

entries.name: Active diagnostic session
entries.description: Record describing the current diagnostic session. Preserved as raw bytes; this catalog does not assume a byte layout or switch sessions.

entries.name: Workshop system name
entries.description: Workshop-facing system-name string reported by the controller. The source names this record, but does not establish that the installed MHS2 provides it.

entries.name: Bootloader identifier
entries.description: Bootloader identification text reported by the controller. Reading an identifier does not back up or update the bootloader.

entries.name: Software block version
entries.description: Logical software-block version string. Kept separate from the main application software version used by the write fingerprint.

entries.name: ECU production revision identifier
entries.description: Production-change identifier reported by the controller. The catalog records the identifier as text without interpreting manufacturer-specific contents.

entries.name: ECU programming information
entries.description: Programming-information record preserved as raw bytes. No counter layout, flashing operation or restore permission is inferred.
